desc: The relay's diet under network trouble: two players in a relay room with 3% of messages dropped, duplicates, reordering and 60-250 ms delays, walking, items and a shared battle. Nothing is sent again on a timer any more: a dropped reliable message is found by the gap after it (said with the acknowledgement), or the last one after 2 s while the other's words still come; no DRIFT, the same progress, the battle ends together (the host's last item and coins come after the battle, while the guest is still there to take them)
